```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 2
## Set up Python and IBM CPLEX
## ============================================================

python_bin <- Sys.which(
  "python3"
)


if (python_bin == "") {

  stop(
    paste(
      "python3 was not found.",
      "Install Python 3 before continuing."
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)


run_python_command <- function(args) {

  out <- suppressWarnings(
    system2(
      python_bin,
      args = args,
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )


  status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )


  if (is.null(status)) {

    status <- 0L
  }


  return(
    list(
      output = out,
      status = status
    )
  )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Check Python CPLEX installation
## ------------------------------------------------------------

check_cplex <- run_python_command(

  c(
    "-c",

    shQuote(
      "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
    )
  )
)


if (check_cplex$status != 0) {

  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found.\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Attempting installation...\n"
  )


  system2(

    python_bin,

    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )


  check_cplex <- run_python_command(

    c(
      "-c",

      shQuote(
        "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
      )
    )
  )
}


if (check_cplex$status != 0) {

  cat(
    paste(
      check_cplex$output,
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n"
  )


  stop(
    "CPLEX could not be imported into Python."
  )
}


cat(
  "CPLEX version:",
  paste(
    check_cplex$output,
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 3
## Create Python CPLEX solver
##
## Important:
## - single thread
## - wall-clock timing
## - 300 second limit supplied from R
## - relative MIP tolerance = 1e-6
## - numerical emphasis enabled because numerical difficulties
##   were observed in the higher-dimensional problems
## ============================================================

CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex.py"
)


python_solver <- c(

  "import sys",

  "import cplex",

  "",

  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",

  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",

  "time_limit = float(sys.argv[3])",

  "",

  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",

  "",

  "# Suppress full solver log",

  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",

  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",

  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",

  "",

  "# Reproducible single-threaded comparison",

  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",

  "",

  "# Explicitly use wall-clock time",

  "problem.parameters.clocktype.set(2)",

  "",

  "# Per-instance wall-clock time limit",

  "problem.parameters.timelimit.set(time_limit)",

  "",

  "# Tight relative MIP optimality tolerance",

  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",

  "",

  "# Extra numerical caution",

  "problem.parameters.emphasis.numerical.set(1)",

  "",

  "try:",

  "    problem.solve()",

  "except Exception as exc:",

  "    print('CPLEX exception:', str(exc))",

  "    try:",

  "        print('CPLEX status code:', problem.solution.get_status())",

  "        print('CPLEX status:', problem.solution.get_status_string())",

  "    except Exception:",

  "        pass",

  "    sys.exit(1)",

  "",

  "status_code = problem.solution.get_status()",

  "status = problem.solution.get_status_string()",

  "",

  "print('CPLEX status code:', status_code)",

  "print('CPLEX status:', status)",

  "",

  "has_solution = problem.solution.is_primal_feasible()",

  "",

  "print('Has primal feasible:', int(has_solution))",

  "",

  "if not has_solution:",

  "    print('No primal feasible solution found.')",

  "    sys.exit(2)",

  "",

  "objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",

  "print('Objective:', objective)",

  "",

  "try:",

  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",

  "    print('MIP gap:', gap)",

  "except Exception:",

  "    pass",

  "",

  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)


writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)


cat(
  "Created CPLEX solver at:\n",
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT,
  "\n"
)
```


```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 4
## Fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX
## ============================================================

best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20,
    time_limit = 300
) {

  n <- nrow(X)

  p <- ncol(X)


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Temporary working directory
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )


  dir.create(
    work
  )


  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )


  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )


  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Write MIQP
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Objective:
  ##
  ## min sum_i r_i^2
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )


  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )


  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    writeLines(

      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),

      con
    )
  }


  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Residual constraints:
  ##
  ## X beta + r = y
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )


  chunk <- 10


  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )


    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {

      start <- starts[
        cc
      ]


      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )


      txt <- ""


      if (cc == 1) {

        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }


      for (j in start:finish) {

        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]


        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {

          next
        }


        if (a >= 0) {

          txt <- paste0(

            txt,

            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )

        } else {

          txt <- paste0(

            txt,

            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }


      if (finish == p) {

        txt <- paste0(

          txt,

          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }


      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Big-M constraints
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (j in seq_len(p)) {

    writeLines(

      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),

      con
    )


    writeLines(

      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),

      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Exactly s selected predictors
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )


  chunk_z <- 25


  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk_z
    )
  ) {

    finish <- min(
      start + chunk_z - 1,
      p
    )


    txt <- ""


    for (j in start:finish) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }


    if (finish == p) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }


    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Bounds
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )


  for (j in seq_len(p)) {

    writeLines(

      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),

      con
    )
  }


  for (i in seq_len(n)) {

    writeLines(

      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),

      con
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Binary variables
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )


  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {

    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )


    txt <- ""


    for (j in start:finish) {

      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }


    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }


  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )


  close(
    con
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Solve
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]


  out <- suppressWarnings(

    system2(

      python_bin,

      args = c(

        shQuote(
          CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
        ),

        shQuote(
          lpfile
        ),

        shQuote(
          solfile
        ),

        as.character(
          time_limit
        )
      ),

      stdout = TRUE,

      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )


  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    solve_start


  process_status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )


  if (is.null(
    process_status
  )) {

    process_status <- 0L
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Helper for parsing solver output
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  get_output_value <- function(
      prefix
  ) {

    line <- grep(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix
      ),
      out,
      value = TRUE
    )


    if (length(line) == 0) {

      return(
        NA_character_
      )
    }


    sub(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix,
        "[[:space:]]*"
      ),
      "",
      line[1]
    )
  }


  status_code_text <- get_output_value(
    "CPLEX status code:"
  )


  cplex_status_code <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      status_code_text
    )
  )


  cplex_status <- get_output_value(
    "CPLEX status:"
  )


  gap_text <- get_output_value(
    "MIP gap:"
  )


  mip_gap <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      gap_text
    )
  )


  objective_text <- get_output_value(
    "Objective:"
  )


  cplex_objective <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      objective_text
    )
  )


  exception_line <- grep(
    "^CPLEX exception:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )


  exception_message <-

    if (length(
      exception_line
    ) > 0) {

      sub(
        "^CPLEX exception:[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        exception_line[1]
      )

    } else {

      NA_character_
    }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## CPLEX status interpretation
  ##
  ## 101 = proven optimal
  ## 102 = optimal within configured MIP tolerance
  ## 107 = time limit, feasible incumbent
  ## 108 = time limit, no feasible incumbent
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  proven_optimal <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    101L


  reference_eligible <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code %in%
    c(
      101L,
      102L
    )


  timed_out <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code %in%
    c(
      107L,
      108L
    )


  has_solution <- file.exists(
    solfile
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Classify outcome
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    101L
  ) {

    outcome <- "optimal"

  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    102L
  ) {

    outcome <- "optimal_tolerance"

  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    107L
  ) {

    outcome <- "time_limit_feasible"

  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    108L
  ) {

    outcome <- "time_limit_no_incumbent"

  } else if (
    !has_solution
  ) {

    outcome <- "solver_failure"

  } else {

    outcome <- "other_feasible"
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## No feasible CPLEX solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (!has_solution) {

    error_message <-

      if (!is.na(
        exception_message
      )) {

        exception_message

      } else if (!is.na(
        cplex_status
      )) {

        paste(
          "CPLEX did not produce a feasible solution.",
          cplex_status
        )

      } else {

        paste(
          "CPLEX did not produce a feasible solution.",
          paste(
            out,
            collapse = " "
          )
        )
      }


    return(
      list(

        selected =
          integer(0),

        beta =
          numeric(p),

        z =
          numeric(p),

        rss =
          NA_real_,

        status =
          cplex_status,

        status_code =
          cplex_status_code,

        mip_gap =
          mip_gap,

        objective =
          cplex_objective,

        solve_seconds =
          solve_seconds,

        max_abs_beta =
          NA_real_,

        has_solution =
          FALSE,

        proven_optimal =
          proven_optimal,

        reference_eligible =
          reference_eligible,

        timed_out =
          timed_out,

        outcome =
          outcome,

        process_status =
          process_status,

        error =
          error_message,

        cplex_output =
          out
      )
    )
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Read XML solution
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )


  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )


  z <- numeric(
    p
  )


  for (line in sol) {

    if (!grepl(
      "<variable",
      line,
      fixed = TRUE
    )) {

      next
    }


    name_match <- regmatches(

      line,

      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]


    if (
      length(
        name_match
      ) != 2
    ) {

      next
    }


    name <- name_match[
      2
    ]


    value_match <- regmatches(

      line,

      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]


    if (
      length(
        value_match
      ) != 2
    ) {

      next
    }


    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[
        2
      ]
    )


    if (grepl(
      "^beta_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {

      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )


      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {

        beta[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }


    if (grepl(
      "^z_[0-9]+$",
      name
    )) {

      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )


      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {

        z[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Diagnostics
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
        X %*% beta
    )^2
  )


  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(beta)
  )


  if (
    max_abs_beta >
      0.95 * M
  ) {

    warning(
      "A CPLEX coefficient is close to Big-M."
    )
  }


  return(
    list(

      selected =
        which(
          z > 0.5
        ),

      beta =
        beta,

      z =
        z,

      rss =
        rss,

      status =
        cplex_status,

      status_code =
        cplex_status_code,

      mip_gap =
        mip_gap,

      objective =
        cplex_objective,

      solve_seconds =
        solve_seconds,

      max_abs_beta =
        max_abs_beta,

      has_solution =
        TRUE,

      proven_optimal =
        proven_optimal,

      reference_eligible =
        reference_eligible,

      timed_out =
        timed_out,

      outcome =
        outcome,

      process_status =
        process_status,

      error =
        NA_character_,

      cplex_output =
        out
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 5
## Experiment 3 settings
## ============================================================


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Data-generating process
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n <- 100


p_values <- c(
  25,
  50,
  75,
  100,
  125,
  150,
  200
)


p_min <- min(
  p_values
)


p_max <- max(
  p_values
)


rho <- 0.20


target_snr <- 2


s_true <- 4


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Monte Carlo replications
## ------------------------------------------------------------

n_rep <- 50

## Use temporarily for testing:
# n_rep <- 2


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## True coefficients
## ------------------------------------------------------------

beta_min <- 1

beta_max <- 2


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## CPLEX
## ------------------------------------------------------------

big_M <- 20


## Five-minute wall-clock budget per CPLEX instance
cplex_time_limit <- 300


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## L0Learn
## ------------------------------------------------------------

l0_max_support <- 20


## Dense initial grid
l0_grid_points <- 1200


## Pilot-based lambda range
l0_upper_multiplier <- 2

l0_lower_multiplier <- 0.02


## Local refinement of skipped cardinalities
l0_refine_points <- 100

l0_refine_rounds <- 2


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Reproducibility
## ------------------------------------------------------------

master_seed <- 12345


cat(
  "Experiment 3 - Effect of Dimensionality\n"
)


cat(
  "n =",
  n,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "p values =",
  paste(
    p_values,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "p/n values =",
  paste(
    round(
      p_values / n,
      2
    ),
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "True model size =",
  s_true,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "rho =",
  rho,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "SNR =",
  target_snr,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "Replications =",
  n_rep,
  "\n"
)


cat(
  "CPLEX time limit =",
  cplex_time_limit,
  "seconds per instance\n"
)


cat(
  "L0Learn dense lambda points =",
  l0_grid_points,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 6
## Generate one Monte Carlo replication
##
## A single n x p_max design is generated.
##
## Smaller dimensional problems use the first p columns.
##
## The true support is sampled entirely from the first p_min
## predictors so that the same true model exists for every p.
##
## The response is identical across all p within a replication.
## Increasing p therefore only adds irrelevant predictors.
## ============================================================

generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p_min,
    p_max,
    rho,
    s_true,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    target_snr,
    master_seed
) {

  set.seed(
    master_seed +
      rep_id
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Equicorrelated Gaussian predictors
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )


  Z <- matrix(

    rnorm(
      n * p_max
    ),

    nrow = n,

    ncol = p_max
  )


  X_raw <-
    sqrt(
      rho
    ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p_max
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 - rho
    ) *
    Z


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Standardise full p_max design once
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  X <- scale(
    X_raw,
    center = TRUE,
    scale = TRUE
  )


  X <- as.matrix(
    X
  )


  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p_max
    )
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True support must be present at every dimensionality
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  true_support <- sort(
    sample(
      seq_len(
        p_min
      ),
      size = s_true,
      replace = FALSE
    )
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## True coefficients
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  magnitudes <- runif(
    s_true,
    min = beta_min,
    max = beta_max
  )


  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size = s_true,
    replace = TRUE
  )


  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes


  beta_true <- numeric(
    p_max
  )


  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <- beta_values


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common signal
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  signal <- as.vector(
    X %*%
      beta_true
  )


  signal_variance <- var(
    signal
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common noise direction
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )


  epsilon_base <- as.numeric(
    scale(
      epsilon_base,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )


  sigma <- sqrt(
    signal_variance /
      target_snr
  )


  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    epsilon_base


  y <-
    signal +
    epsilon


  y <-
    y -
    mean(y)


  realised_snr <-
    var(signal) /
    var(epsilon)


  return(
    list(

      X =
        X,

      y =
        y,

      beta_true =
        beta_true,

      true_support =
        true_support,

      beta_values =
        beta_values,

      signal =
        signal,

      epsilon =
        epsilon,

      sigma =
        sigma,

      realised_snr =
        realised_snr
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 8
## Common helper functions
## ============================================================


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## OLS refit
## ------------------------------------------------------------

ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {

  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )


  p <- ncol(
    X
  )


  if (
    length(
      support
    ) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      list(

        beta =
          numeric(p),

        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(y)
          ),

        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }


  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )


  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )


  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients


  return(
    list(

      beta =
        beta,

      fitted =
        as.vector(
          fit$fitted.values
        ),

      rss =
        sum(
          fit$residuals^2
        )
    )
  )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Support recovery metrics
## ------------------------------------------------------------

support_metrics <- function(
    selected,
    truth
) {

  selected <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        selected
      )
    )
  )


  truth <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        truth
      )
    )
  )


  TP <- length(
    intersect(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  FP <- length(
    setdiff(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  FN <- length(
    setdiff(
      truth,
      selected
    )
  )


  precision <-

    if (
      length(
        selected
      ) > 0
    ) {

      TP /
        length(
          selected
        )

    } else {

      NA_real_
    }


  recall <-
    TP /
    length(
      truth
    )


  union_size <- length(
    union(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )


  jaccard <-

    if (
      union_size > 0
    ) {

      TP /
        union_size

    } else {

      1
    }


  exact <- setequal(
    selected,
    truth
  )


  return(
    list(

      exact =
        exact,

      TP =
        TP,

      FP =
        FP,

      FN =
        FN,

      precision =
        precision,

      recall =
        recall,

      jaccard =
        jaccard
    )
  )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Safe summary helpers
## ------------------------------------------------------------

mean_safe <- function(x) {

  if (
    length(x) == 0 ||
    all(
      is.na(x)
    )
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


median_safe <- function(x) {

  if (

    all(
      is.na(x)
    )
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


min_safe <- function(x) {

  if (

    all(
      is.na(x)
    )
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  min(

}


max_safe <- function(x) {

      is.na(x)
    )
  ) {

    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }


  max(

    na.rm = TRUE
  )

value_or <- function(
    x,
    default
) {

  if (
    is.null(x) ||
    length(x) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      default
    )
  }


  x
}
```

```{r}
        success =

        runtime =

        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,

        status =
          fit$status,

        status_code =

        mip_gap =
          fit$mip_gap,

        proven_optimal =
          fit$proven_optimal,

        reference_eligible =
          fit$reference_eligible,

        timed_out =
          fit$timed_out,

        has_incumbent =
          FALSE,

        outcome =
          fit$outcome,

        max_abs_beta =
          fit$max_abs_beta,

        error =
          fit$error
      )
    )
  }


  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$selected
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      success =
        TRUE,

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        length(
          support
        ) ==
        s,

      status =
        fit$status,

      status_code =
        fit$status_code,

      mip_gap =
        fit$mip_gap,

      proven_optimal =
        fit$proven_optimal,

      reference_eligible =
        fit$reference_eligible,

      timed_out =
        fit$timed_out,

      has_incumbent =
        TRUE,

      outcome =
```

```{r}
fit_combss_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Selectively suppress only the glmnet deprecation warnings
  ## encountered with the current COMBSS dependency stack.
  ## Other warnings remain visible.
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(

    combss::combss(

      x = X,

      y = y,

      family = "gaussian",

      q = s,

      lam_ridge = 0,

      Niter = 25,

      alpha = 0.01,

      scale = FALSE,

      verbose = FALSE
    ),

    warning = function(w) {

      msg <- conditionMessage(
        w
      )


      if (
        grepl(
          "Passing 'thresh' to glmnet",
          msg,
          fixed = TRUE
        ) ||
        grepl(
          "Passing 'maxit' to glmnet",
          msg,
          fixed = TRUE
        )
      ) {

        invokeRestart(
          "muffleWarning"
        )
      }
    }
  )


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time


  if (
    length(
      fit$subset_list
    ) < s
  ) {

    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        s
      )
    )
  }


  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[
        s
      ]]
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        length(
          support
        ) ==
        s
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
fit_abess_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  fit <- abess::abess(

    x = X,

    y = y,

    family = "gaussian",

    tune.path = "sequence",

    support.size = s,

    tune.type = "gic",

    lambda = 0,

    normalize = 0,

    fit.intercept = FALSE,

    early.stop = FALSE,

    warm.start = TRUE,

    num.threads = 1
  )


  model <- abess::extract(
    fit,
    support.size = s
  )


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time


  beta_hat <- as.numeric(
    model$beta
  )


  support <- sort(
    which(
      abs(
        beta_hat
      ) >
        1e-10
    )
  )


  return(
    list(

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        length(
          support
        ) ==
        s
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 12
## Dense L0Learn path with gap refinement
## ============================================================

fit_l0learn_dense <- function(
    X,
    y,
    target_s,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {

  total_start <- proc.time()[3]


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 1
  ## Pilot automatic path
  ## ==========================================================

  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(

    x = X,

    y = y,

    loss = "SquaredError",

    penalty = "L0",

    algorithm = "CD",

    maxSuppSize =
      max_support,

    nLambda = 100,

    scaleDownFactor = 0.80,

    intercept = FALSE
  )


  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[1]]
  )


  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
      pilot_lambda >
      0
  ]


  if (
    length(
      pilot_lambda
    ) < 2
  ) {

    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }


  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    upper_multiplier


  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    lower_multiplier


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 2
  ## Initial dense logarithmic grid
  ## ==========================================================

  lambda_grid <- exp(

    seq(

      from =
        log(
          lambda_upper
        ),

      to =
        log(
          lambda_lower
        ),

      length.out =
        grid_points
    )
  )


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 3
  ## Helper for fitting one explicit grid
  ## ==========================================================

  fit_grid <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {

    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(

      x = X,

      y = y,

      loss = "SquaredError",

      penalty = "L0",

      algorithm = "CDPSI",

      maxSuppSize =
        max_support,

      lambdaGrid =
        list(
          lambda_values
        ),

      partialSort = TRUE,

      maxIters = 200,

      rtol = 1e-6,

      atol = 1e-9,

      activeSet = TRUE,

      activeSetNum = 3,

      maxSwaps = 100,

      screenSize = ncol(X),

      intercept = FALSE
    )
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 4
  ## Initial CDPSI fit
  ## ==========================================================

  fit <- fit_grid(
    lambda_grid
  )


  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[1]]
  )


  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[1]]
  )


  rounds_used <- 0L


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 5
  ## Refine every lambda interval where model size jumps by > 1
  ## ==========================================================

  for (
    refinement_round in seq_len(
      refine_rounds
    )
  ) {

    if (
      length(
        support_sizes
      ) < 2
    ) {

      break
    }


    gap_indices <- which(
      abs(
        diff(
          support_sizes
        )
      ) > 1
    )


    if (
      length(
        gap_indices
      ) == 0
    ) {

      break
    }


    extra_lambda <- numeric(
      0
    )


    for (i in gap_indices) {

      lambda_a <- fitted_lambda[
        i
      ]


      lambda_b <- fitted_lambda[
        i + 1
      ]


      upper <- max(
        lambda_a,
        lambda_b
      )


      lower <- min(
        lambda_a,
        lambda_b
      )


      if (
        is.finite(
          upper
        ) &&
        is.finite(
          lower
        ) &&
        lower > 0 &&
        upper > lower
      ) {

        local_grid <- exp(

          seq(

            from =
              log(
                upper
              ),

            to =
              log(
                lower
              ),

            length.out =
              refine_points +
              2
          )
        )


        local_grid <- local_grid[
          -c(
            1,
            length(
              local_grid
            )
          )
        ]


        extra_lambda <- c(
          extra_lambda,
          local_grid
        )
      }
    }


    if (
      length(
        extra_lambda
      ) == 0
    ) {

      break
    }


    lambda_grid <- sort(
      unique(
        c(
          lambda_grid,
          extra_lambda
        )
      ),
      decreasing = TRUE
    )


    fit <- fit_grid(
      lambda_grid
    )


    support_sizes <- as.integer(
      fit$suppSize[[1]]
    )


    fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
      fit$lambda[[1]]
    )


    rounds_used <-
      refinement_round
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 6
  ## Extract path information
  ## ==========================================================

  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[1]]
  )


  if (
    ncol(
      beta_path
    ) !=
    length(
      support_sizes
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "L0Learn beta path and support-size path have inconsistent lengths."
    )
  }


  available_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes
    )
  )


  available_sizes <- available_sizes[
    available_sizes <=
      max_support
  ]


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 7
  ## Extract requested target size
  ## ==========================================================

  exact_indices <- which(
    support_sizes ==
      target_s
  )


  exact_size_available <-
    length(
      exact_indices
    ) >
    0


  support <- integer(
    0
  )


  selected_lambda <- NA_real_


  if (
    exact_size_available
  ) {

    candidate_rss <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )


    candidate_supports <- vector(
      mode = "list",
      length = length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )


    for (
      ii in seq_along(
        exact_indices
      )
    ) {

      j <- exact_indices[
        ii
      ]


      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        j
      ]


      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
            1e-10
        )
      )


      candidate_supports[[
        ii
      ]] <- support_j


      candidate_rss[
        ii
      ] <- ols_refit(

        X = X,

        y = y,

        support =
          support_j

      )$rss
    }


    best_candidate <- which.min(
      candidate_rss
    )


    best_index <- exact_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]


    support <- candidate_supports[[
      best_candidate
    ]]


    selected_lambda <- fitted_lambda[
      best_index
    ]
  }


  ## ==========================================================
  ## STEP 8
  ## Nearest-size diagnostic
  ## ==========================================================

  nearest_size <-

    if (
      length(
        available_sizes
      ) > 0
    ) {

      available_sizes[
        which.min(
          abs(
            available_sizes -
              target_s
          )
        )
      ]

    } else {

      NA_integer_
    }


  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start


  return(
    list(

      support =
        support,

      runtime =
        runtime,

      exact_size_available =
        exact_size_available,

      selected_lambda =
        selected_lambda,

      available_sizes =
        available_sizes,

      number_distinct_sizes =
        length(
          available_sizes
        ),

      nearest_size =
        nearest_size,

      refined =
        rounds_used >
        0,

      refinement_rounds_used =
        rounds_used,

      number_lambda_values =
        length(
          fitted_lambda
        ),

      raw_support_sizes =
        support_sizes,

      fit =
        fit
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 14
## Safe fitting wrapper
##
## Runtime is retained even when a method fails.
## ============================================================

safe_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    ...
) {

  start_time <- proc.time()[3]


  tryCatch(

    {

      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )


      if (is.null(
        ans$runtime
      )) {

        ans$runtime <-
          proc.time()[3] -
          start_time
      }


      if (is.null(
        ans$success
      )) {

        ans$success <- TRUE
      }


      if (is.null(
        ans$error
      )) {

        ans$error <- NA_character_
      }


      return(
        ans
      )
    },

    error = function(e) {

      return(
        list(

          success =
            FALSE,

          support =
            integer(0),

          runtime =
            proc.time()[3] -
            start_time,

          exact_size_available =
            FALSE,

          error =
            conditionMessage(
              e
            )
        )
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 15
## Convert one fit into a result row
## ============================================================

make_result_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    p_value,
    method,
    fit,
    data
) {

  fit_success <- isTRUE(
    fit$success
  )


  exact_size_available <- isTRUE(
    fit$exact_size_available
  )


  valid_support <-
    fit_success &&
    exact_size_available


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Metrics when a usable fixed-size solution exists
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    valid_support
  ) {

    selected <- sort(
      as.integer(
        fit$support
      )
    )


    metrics <- support_metrics(

      selected =
        selected,

      truth =
        data$true_support
    )


    refit <- ols_refit(

      X =
        data$X,

      y =
        data$y,

      support =
        selected
    )


    selected_size <- length(
      selected
    )


    exact_recovery <- metrics$exact

    TP <- metrics$TP

    FP <- metrics$FP

    FN <- metrics$FN

    precision <- metrics$precision

    recall <- metrics$recall

    jaccard <- metrics$jaccard

    rss <- refit$rss


    support_key <- paste(
      selected,
      collapse = ","
    )

  } else {

    selected_size <- NA_integer_

    exact_recovery <- NA

    TP <- NA_integer_

    FP <- NA_integer_

    FN <- NA_integer_

    precision <- NA_real_

    recall <- NA_real_

    jaccard <- NA_real_

    rss <- NA_real_

    support_key <- NA_character_
  }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## CPLEX-specific diagnostics
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  cplex_status <- value_or(
    fit$status,
    NA_character_
  )


  cplex_status_code <- value_or(
    fit$status_code,
    NA_integer_
  )


  cplex_gap <- value_or(
    fit$mip_gap,
    NA_real_
  )


  cplex_proven_optimal <- value_or(
    fit$proven_optimal,
    NA
  )


  cplex_reference_eligible <- value_or(
    fit$reference_eligible,
    NA
  )


  cplex_timed_out <- value_or(
    fit$timed_out,
    NA
  )


  cplex_has_incumbent <- value_or(
    fit$has_incumbent,
    NA
  )


  cplex_outcome <- value_or(
    fit$outcome,
    NA_character_
  )


  big_m_ratio <-

    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$max_abs_beta
      ) &&
      is.finite(
        fit$max_abs_beta
      )
    ) {

      fit$max_abs_beta /
        big_M

    } else {

      NA_real_
    }


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## L0Learn diagnostics
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  l0_distinct_sizes <- value_or(
    fit$number_distinct_sizes,
    NA_integer_
  )


  l0_available_sizes <-

    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$available_sizes
      )
    ) {

      paste(
        fit$available_sizes,
        collapse = ","
      )

    } else {

      NA_character_
    }


  l0_nearest_size <- value_or(
    fit$nearest_size,
    NA_integer_
  )


  l0_refined <- value_or(
    fit$refined,
    NA
  )


  l0_refinement_rounds <- value_or(
    fit$refinement_rounds_used,
    NA_integer_
  )


  l0_lambda_points <- value_or(
    fit$number_lambda_values,
    NA_integer_
  )


  return(
    data.frame(

      rep =
        rep_id,

      n =
        nrow(
          data$X
        ),

      p =
        p_value,

      p_over_n =
        p_value /
        nrow(
          data$X
        ),

      s_true =
        length(
          data$true_support
        ),

      method =
        method,

      success =
        fit_success,

      exact_size_available =
        exact_size_available,

      selected_size =
        selected_size,

      exact_recovery =
        exact_recovery,

      TP =
        TP,

      FP =
        FP,

      FN =
        FN,

      precision =
        precision,

      recall =
        recall,

      jaccard =
        jaccard,

      rss =
        rss,

      runtime =
        value_or(
          fit$runtime,
          NA_real_
        ),

      sigma =
        data$sigma,

      realised_snr =
        data$realised_snr,

      support_key =
        support_key,

      true_support_key =
        paste(
          data$true_support,
          collapse = ","
        ),

      cplex_status =
        cplex_status,

      cplex_status_code =
        cplex_status_code,

      cplex_gap =
        cplex_gap,

      cplex_proven_optimal =
        cplex_proven_optimal,

      cplex_reference_eligible =
        cplex_reference_eligible,

      cplex_timed_out =
        cplex_timed_out,

      cplex_has_incumbent =
        cplex_has_incumbent,

      cplex_outcome =
        cplex_outcome,

      big_m_ratio =
        big_m_ratio,

      l0_distinct_sizes =
        l0_distinct_sizes,

      l0_available_sizes =
        l0_available_sizes,

      l0_nearest_size =
        l0_nearest_size,

      l0_refined =
        l0_refined,

      l0_refinement_rounds =
        l0_refinement_rounds,

      l0_lambda_points =
        l0_lambda_points,

      error =
        value_or(
          fit$error,
          NA_character_
        ),

      stringsAsFactors =
        FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 17
## Main Experiment 3
##
## Results are checkpointed after EVERY method fit.
##
## The checkpoint filename is specific to:
## n = 100
## R = 50
## CPLEX limit = 300 seconds
##
## This means the experiment can be restarted without losing
## completed fits.
## ============================================================

output_dir <- "experiment3_results"


dir.create(
  output_dir,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


checkpoint_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "experiment3_checkpoint_n100_R50_T300.rds"
)


resume_from_checkpoint <- TRUE


if (
  resume_from_checkpoint &&
  file.exists(
    checkpoint_file
  )
) {

  results <- readRDS(
    checkpoint_file
  )


  cat(
    "Loaded checkpoint with",
    nrow(results),
    "completed method fits.\n"
  )

} else {

  results <- NULL
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Check whether a method / replication / p combination exists
## ------------------------------------------------------------

already_completed <- function(
    rep_id,
    p_value,
    method_name
) {

  if (
    is.null(
      results
    ) ||
    nrow(
      results
    ) == 0
  ) {

    return(
      FALSE
    )
  }


  any(
    results$rep ==
      rep_id &
    results$p ==
      p_value &
    results$method ==
      method_name
  )
}


## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Append one result and immediately checkpoint
## ------------------------------------------------------------

save_one_result <- function(
    row
) {

  results <<- bind_rows(
    results,
    row
  )


  saveRDS(
    results,
    checkpoint_file
  )
}


experiment_start <- Sys.time()


for (
  r in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {

  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )


  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )


  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )


  ## ----------------------------------------------------------
  ## Common n x p_max design, support, coefficients and response
  ## ----------------------------------------------------------

  base <- generate_replication_base(

    rep_id =
      r,

    n =
      n,

    p_min =
      p_min,

    p_max =
      p_max,

    rho =
      rho,

    s_true =
      s_true,

    beta_min =
      beta_min,

    beta_max =
      beta_max,

    target_snr =
      target_snr,

    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )


  for (
    p_value in p_values
  ) {

    cat(
      "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )


    cat(
      "p =",
      p_value,
      " | p/n =",
      round(
        p_value / n,
        2
      ),
      "\n"
    )


    data <- make_dataset_p(

      base =
        base,

      p_value =
        p_value
    )


    ## ========================================================
    ## CPLEX
    ## ========================================================

    if (!already_completed(
      r,
      p_value,
      "CPLEX"
    )) {

      cat(
        "  CPLEX..."
      )


      fit <- safe_fit(

        fit_cplex_method,

        X =
          data$X,

        y =
          data$y,

        s =
          s_true,

        M =
          big_M,

        time_limit =
          cplex_time_limit
      )


      row <- make_result_row(

        rep_id =
          r,

        p_value =
          p_value,

        method =
          "CPLEX",

        fit =
          fit,

        data =
          data
      )


      save_one_result(
        row
      )


      cat(
        " done in",
        round(
          fit$runtime,
          2
        ),
        "seconds"
      )


      if (
        !is.null(
          fit$outcome
        )
      ) {

        cat(
          " |",
          fit$outcome
        )
      }


      cat(
        "\n"
      )

    } else {

      cat(
        "  CPLEX already completed - skipping.\n"
      )
    }


    ## ========================================================
    ## COMBSS
    ## ========================================================

    if (!already_completed(
      r,
      p_value,
      "COMBSS"
    )) {

      cat(
        "  COMBSS..."
      )


      fit <- safe_fit(

        fit_combss_method,

        X =
          data$X,

        y =
          data$y,

        s =
          s_true
      )


      row <- make_result_row(

        rep_id =
          r,

        p_value =
          p_value,

        method =
          "COMBSS",

        fit =
          fit,

        data =
          data
      )


      save_one_result(
        row
      )


      cat(
        " done in",
        round(
          fit$runtime,
          2
        ),
        "seconds\n"
      )

    } else {

      cat(
        "  COMBSS already completed - skipping.\n"
      )
    }


    ## ========================================================
    ## ABESS
    ## ========================================================

    if (!already_completed(
      r,
      p_value,
      "ABESS"
    )) {

      cat(
        "  ABESS..."
      )


      fit <- safe_fit(

        fit_abess_method,

        X =
          data$X,

        y =
          data$y,

        s =
          s_true
      )


      row <- make_result_row(

        rep_id =
          r,

        p_value =
          p_value,

        method =
          "ABESS",

        fit =
          fit,

        data =
          data
      )


      save_one_result(
        row
      )


      cat(
        " done in",
        round(
          fit$runtime,
          2
        ),
        "seconds\n"
      )

    } else {

      cat(
        "  ABESS already completed - skipping.\n"
      )
    }


    ## ========================================================
    ## L0Learn
    ## ========================================================

    if (!already_completed(
      r,
      p_value,
      "L0Learn"
    )) {

      cat(
        "  L0Learn..."
      )


      fit <- safe_fit(

        fit_l0learn_method,

        X =
          data$X,

        y =
          data$y,

        s =
          s_true
      )


      row <- make_result_row(

        rep_id =
          r,

        p_value =
          p_value,

        method =
          "L0Learn",

        fit =
          fit,

        data =
          data
      )


      save_one_result(
        row
      )


      cat(
        " done in",
        round(
          fit$runtime,
          2
        ),
        "seconds\n"
      )

    } else {

      cat(
        "  L0Learn already completed - skipping.\n"
      )
    }


    cat(
      "  Checkpoint saved.\n"
    )
  }


  elapsed <- difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    experiment_start,
    units = "hours"
  )


  cat(
    "\nReplication",
    r,
    "complete."
  )


  cat(
    " Elapsed this session:",
    round(
      as.numeric(
        elapsed
      ),
      2
    ),
    "hours.\n"
  )
}


experiment_end <- Sys.time()


results <- results %>%
  arrange(
    rep,
    p,
    method
  )


saveRDS(
  results,
  checkpoint_file
)


cat(
  "\nExperiment completed.\n"
)


cat(
  "Total elapsed time this session:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
      experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 21
## Compare approximate methods with valid CPLEX benchmarks
##
## IMPORTANT:
##
## CPLEX is used as an optimisation benchmark ONLY if status is
## 101 or 102:
##
## 101 = proven optimal
## 102 = optimal within the configured 1e-6 MIP tolerance
##
## A 300-second time-limited incumbent is NOT used as the
## benchmark.
## ============================================================

cplex_reference <- results %>%

  filter(
    method ==
      "CPLEX",
    success,
    exact_size_available,
    cplex_reference_eligible %in%
      TRUE
  ) %>%

  select(

    rep,

    p,

    cplex_support_key =
      support_key,

    cplex_rss =
      rss,

    cplex_reference_status =
      cplex_status,

    cplex_reference_gap =
      cplex_gap
  )


results <- results %>%

  left_join(

    cplex_reference,

    by = c(
      "rep",
      "p"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    agrees_with_cplex =

      ifelse(

        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_support_key
          ),

        support_key ==
          cplex_support_key,

        NA
      ),


    relative_rss_gap =

      ifelse(

        success &
          exact_size_available &
          !is.na(
            cplex_rss
          ),

        (
          rss -
            cplex_rss
        ) /
          cplex_rss,

        NA_real_
      )
  )
```

```{r}
## ============================================================
## SECTION 24
## Exact support recovery versus dimensionality
## ============================================================

recovery_plot_data <- results %>%

  filter(
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    p,
    method
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    recovery_rate =
      mean(
        exact_recovery
      ),

    n_available =
      n(),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    se =
      sqrt(
        recovery_rate *
          (
            1 -
              recovery_rate
          ) /
          n_available
      ),

    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        recovery_rate -
          1.96 *
          se
      ),

    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        recovery_rate +
          1.96 *
          se
      )
  )


p_recovery <- ggplot(

  recovery_plot_data,

  aes(

    x =
      p,

    y =
      recovery_rate,

    group =
      method,

    linetype =
      method,

    shape =
      method
  )

) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = n,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  geom_line() +

  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(

    aes(
      ymin =
        lower,
      ymax =
        upper
    ),

    width = 4
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      p_values
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x =
      "Number of predictors p",
    y =
      "Exact support recovery rate",
    linetype =
      "Method",
    shape =
      "Method"
  ) +
```

```{r}
## ============================================================

gap_plot_data <- results %>%

  filter(
    method !=
      "CPLEX",
    !is.na(
      relative_rss_gap
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    relative_rss_gap =
      pmax(
        relative_rss_gap,
        0
      )
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    p,
    method
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    median_gap =
      median(
        relative_rss_gap,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    number_with_reference =
      n(),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )


p_gap <- ggplot(

  gap_plot_data,

  aes(

    x =
      p,

    y =
      median_gap +
      1e-12,

    group =
      method,

    linetype =
      method,

    shape =
      method
  )

) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = n,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +

  geom_line() +

  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks =
      p_values
  ) +

  scale_y_log10() +

  labs(

      "Number of predictors p",
```
